native_map_observation: Live smaps sampling showed aggregate workerd growth largely in anonymous data. V8 heap capacity increased across the process even as engine live allocations dropped in collection cycles. The isolate sampler does not attribute all native pages to individual isolates.

method.note: Compressed loose/Solution cadence with cold four-seat bursts, one hot seat and signed reconnect. Tracemalloc is diagnostic and adds local CPU and memory. The previous one-hour run used 30-second cadence.

projection.note: Local sensitivity calculation, not a hosted limit measurement. Adds the largest V8 reported engine sample and observed WASM capacity, which can overlap. Tracemalloc counts live Python allocations, not physical pages. V8 also exhibited collection cycles. Workerd process RSS covers multiple isolates.
